blacklistabilityReview.evidence: sUSDS is structurally linked to usds-sky by both variantOf and mintAuthority.inheritedFrom. Current-head reads on 2026-08-08 resolved the four tracked proxies as follows: Ethereum block 25711847 to 0x4e7991e5c547ce825bdeb665ee14a3274f9f61e0; Base block 49711042 to 0x982f2df63fe38ab8d55f4b1464e8cfdc8ea5dec8; Optimism block 155306328 to 0x6f0888dda6a5e35451d5be0fabb20171715788b3; Arbitrum block 492469331 to 0x5aee6b37d6e31860804575aee3e2f368a0a428e7. Each EIP-1967 admin slot was zero, and each current verified implementation exposed ordinary holder transfers and ward-gated UUPS upgrades but no current blacklist, pause, seizure, or holder-freeze function. The inherited parent remains freeze-positive: finalized Solana slots 438038182 and 438038183 returned active USDS freezeAuthority AYPtjx4Hc8us1ikULUedkmZ3wtiD6tmL7gK3qe4V3oHt. Therefore the freeze disposition is inherited from usds-sky, while local UUPS transfer restrictability remains captured by the deployment overlay.

oracleRisk.summary: sUSDS is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDS and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required USDS parent carries the separately reviewed Sky Vault oracle, auction, backstop, and bad-debt branch.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sUSDS's ERC-4626 conversion functions use the savings accumulator to value USDS assets per share for deposits, minting, withdrawals, and redemption, making the share exchange rate a price-sensitive top-level authority. The wrapper has no borrower debt or local liquidation markets, so no branch rows are required.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sUSDS is issued natively only by the Sky Savings USDS vault on Ethereum. Base, OP Mainnet, and Arbitrum are SkyLink canonical-rollup lock/mint representations; their destination-token wards, UUPS implementations, L2 bridges/gateway, governance relays, canonical L1 bridges, and escrows are Bridge Risk rather than native Mint Authority. The intended route is supply-conserving through canonical lock, finalized messaging, destination mint, and withdrawal burn, but the reviewed destination ward surfaces can mint directly and the bridge machinery is upgradeable/administered. A near-synchronous 2026-07-21 totalSupply snapshot attributes 342,446,332.180536477297262823 sUSDS, or 7.9776341236% of canonical Ethereum supply, to those three representations.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: OpenAI Codex C01 mint/bridge boundary migration

routes.reviewNote: sUSDS is the ERC-4626 savings wrapper natively issued on Ethereum by the Sky Savings USDS vault (variantOf usds-sky); shares mint against deposited USDS, no bridge representation. Same native convention as the reviewed usds-sky ethereum row. At Ethereum block 25583986, eth_call totalSupply() returned 4,292,580,066.641414652615533299 sUSDS. Subtracting the near-synchronous Base, OP Mainnet, and Arbitrum representation supplies leaves 3,950,133,734.460878175318270476 sUSDS economically resident on Ethereum (92.0223658763%).

Controller verified on-chain 2026-07-20: wards(0xee44cdb68d618d58f75d9fe0818b640bd7b8a7b7) = 1 on the Base sUSDS token, so the SkyLink OP Token Bridge (same controller as the reviewed usds-sky Base row) is the mint authority for this representation; Sky governance relay holds admin. At Base block 48941163, eth_call totalSupply() returned 10,829,128.842209047357151231 sUSDS, equal to 0.2522755236% of the canonical Ethereum supply measured six seconds earlier.
